meta.title: Rules at the Science Museum
meta.textType: functional: signs, rules, and directions in a museum

paragraphs: On Saturday, August eighth, the Explorers arrive at the science museum. A sign by the door says, "Science Museum, open from nine to five." Lily, Mia, Leo, and May walk in with Teacher Kim. Guide Ann works at the museum, and she meets them at the door. She says, "Hello! I am your guide today." "The space show begins at half past ten in Room Three." "Before the show, you can see the exhibition about the Earth."

The Earth exhibition has a big model of our planet. Next to it, there is a model rocket on a stand. The rocket is made of metal. A sign by the models says, "Please do not touch the models." Leo looks at the rocket and puts his hands behind his back. "Can I touch the rocket?" he asks. "No," says Guide Ann. "If visitors touch the models, they get dirty." Mia laughs and says, "Good, Leo. Hands behind your back!"

Another sign says, "No running on the stairs." Guide Ann points to the stairs. "Take the stairs to Floor Two," she says. "Then turn left." "Room Three is at the end." The children walk up the stairs one by one. A sign at the top says, "Space Show, half past ten, Room Three, Floor Two." May asks, "Is this the right room?" "Yes, it is," says Teacher Kim.

In Room Three, the space show begins. "If visitors want to take photos, they can," says Guide Ann. "But please do not use a flash." "If you use a flash, other visitors can't see the screen." Mia takes a photo of the planets without a flash. After the show, May reads a sign at the experiment table. It says, "If you push the green button, the lamp turns on." May pushes the button, and the lamp turns on. "It works!" says May. "Good rules make a good visit," says Teacher Kim.
text.summary: The Explorers visit the science museum. Guide Ann tells them the times, the rules, and the way to the space show, and they read the signs.
